# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: No comments found. (Type: array)
  - **data[].address**: 餐厅地址 (Type: string)
  - **data[].cityCode**: 城市编码 (Type: string)
  - **data[].cityName**: 城市名称 (Type: string)
  - **data[].latitude**: 纬度 (Type: number)
  - **data[].longitude**: 经度 (Type: number)
  - **data[].name**: 餐厅名称 (Type: string)
  - **data[].shortName**: 餐厅短名称 (Type: string)
  - **data[].code**: 餐厅编码 (Type: string)
  - **data[].distance**: 距离 (Type: integer)
  - **data[].distanceText**: 距离文本 (Type: string)
  - **data[].businessStatus**: 营业状态 (Type: integer)
  - **data[].onlineBusinessStatus**: No comments found. (Type: boolean)
- **message**: No comments found. (Type: string)
- **traceId**: No comments found. (Type: string)
